Doctor: public ICollection<Appointment> Appointments { get; private set; } = new List<Appointment>()

requirements: Appointment: public Patient? Patient { get; set; } — navigation property
Appointment: public Doctor? Doctor { get; set; } — navigation property

requirements.text: Appointment: protected Appointment() — parameterless ctor для EF Core (з безпечними дефолтами для private set полів)

requirements: UrgentAppointment.UrgencyNote: змінено з { get; } на { get; private set; } — EF може встановити після конструктора
UrgentAppointment: protected UrgentAppointment() parameterless ctor для EF
SpecialistAppointment (sealed class): private SpecialistAppointment() для EF (sealed + protected безглуздо)
SpecialistAppointment.ConsultationTopic: змінено з { get; } на { get; private set; }
ClinicDbContext: DbSet<Appointment> Appointments { get; set; }
Appointment конфігурація: ToTable("Appointments"), HasKey(a => a.Id), ValueGeneratedOnAdd
Appointment: HasOne(a => a.Doctor).WithMany(d => d.Appointments).HasForeignKey(a => a.DoctorId).OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.Restrict)

requirements.text: OnDelete: ТІЛЬКИ ОДИН CASCADE (Patient→Appointments); Doctor→Appointments — Restrict (SQL Server забороняє два cascade на одну таблицю)

modelBuilder.Entity<SpecialistAppointment>(): Property ConsultationTopic HasMaxLength(200) HasDefaultValue("")

requirements: Файл src/Data/ClinicRepository.cs: клас ClinicRepository

requirements.text: GetPatientWithAppointments(int patientId): context.Patients.Include(p => p.Appointments).FirstOrDefault(p => p.Id == patientId); повертає Patient?

requirements: GetUpcomingAppointments(): включає .Include(a => a.Patient) і .Include(a => a.Doctor) — два Include
GetUpcomingAppointments(): фільтрує за ScheduledAt > DateTime.Now та Status == Scheduled (або аналог)
GetAppointmentsByPatient(int patientId): .Include(a => a.Doctor).Where(a => a.PatientId == patientId).OrderByDescending(a => a.ScheduledAt)

requirements.text: GetDoctorStats(): .AsNoTracking().Include(d => d.Appointments).Select(d => new { d.Id, d.FirstName, Count = d.Appointments.Count() })
AsNoTracking() явно присутній у GetDoctorStats() — read-only запит без Change Tracker overhead
